edges.notes: Many SYCL implementations target OpenCL as a backend runtime; not exclusive across all implementations.
Major SYCL compilers are LLVM-based and lower through LLVM IR-class compilation pipelines.
Typical SYCL deployments on Linux hosts with vendor GPU/accelerator drivers.
AMD ROCm-related SYCL tooling paths exist in the ecosystem (implementation-dependent).
Overlapping portable accelerator programming space vs NVIDIA CUDA’s native programming model.
Intel SYCL / oneAPI GPU stacks commonly use Level Zero as a low-level backend on supported configurations.
